title: Source-gap reference integrity and complete Foundation work-package registry

acceptance_gates.description: A source gap whose blocks array names an unregistered work package fails verification, so a governance control cannot be silently disarmed by a typo, a deleted package, or a rename.
Every Foundation work package named by the v1.2 execution plan is registered, so the control-plane report distinguishes work that is finished from work that was never recorded.
SRC-001 now blocks a registered work package (FND-DB-DOMAIN), and that package is excluded from the eligible-work listing while the gap remains open.

rollback: Revert the control-plane commits. Reverting restores a state in which SRC-001 blocks nothing and the Foundation registry is incomplete, so a revert should be paired with an alternative correction.
